Rainy C: Hi team, Rainy here. First day in Product Infra. Quick setup questions: where do I request the dev laptop image, who helps with VPN access, and where do I find the standard devcontainer? Also happy to join any intro calls later.

Ezra H: Welcome Rainy! For laptop request open a ticket at https://support.redwood.ai/new-laptop and choose 'developer image'. VPN is via Okta, ping #eng-security if the invite doesn't arrive. Devcontainer is in git.redwood.ai/tools/devcontainer.json.

Lola M: Hi Rainy, I'll add you to the GitHub teams once you share your handle. I can do a 30 minute pairing session on VPN/SSH at 2pm PT today if that works.

devex-bot: Welcome Rainy. Onboarding checklist created: https://onboard.redwood.ai/2169999999. Remaining items: request laptop, accept Okta invite, add SSH key. Reply 'laptop done' or 'okta done' to update.

Rainy C: Thanks all. GitHub handle is rainyc. I'll file the laptop ticket now and join the 2pm pairing. Also, where do new hires grab stickers?

Ezra H: Stickers are in reception or order remotely at https://orders.redwood.ai/stickers and select 'new-hire pack'. See you at 2pm.

Rainy C: Filed ticket SUP-4021 and pinged here. Joining the pairing in a bit. Thanks for the quick help!
